dct_description_sm: An updated version of this data with landscape unit 3 (the other area sampled during the same time period) is available at Data for Oil Sands Monitoring - Terrestrial Mammals - 2021–2022 https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/AIIA9G

Data on boreal mammal communities from Alberta, Canada, conducted for the joint Federal-Provincial Oil Sands Monitoring program (Terrestrial Biological Monitoring group). The data describes the sampling locations of remote infrared camera arrays, the locations of those arrays, the mammal data collected from the cameras, and the landscapes surrounding those arrays.
